Greece Urges UK to Return Parthenon Marbles

Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis has urged the United Kingdom to show "political will and courage" in discussions regarding the permanent return of the Parthenon Marbles to Athens. The call follows years of talks with the British Museum, which currently holds the sculptures. Andy Burnham had previously stated in 2023 that the sculptures should be returned to Greece with "no strings attached."
